title: @geraldcombs: Wireshark 5.0 (due out in a couple of weeks) will let you view packet bytes as UTF-8. Any multibyte glyph will be rendered as the glyph itse
summary: Wireshark 5.0 will allow users to view packet bytes as UTF-8 thanks to Jinzhou Zhang.
